confidenceRubric.fact: Confidence measures support for the stated claim, not whether the outcome is favorable. High requires a specific, fresh source appropriate to the claim; a current proxy can be high-confidence evidence when it supports a bounded planning conclusion and is not presented as a 2027 confirmation.
confidenceRubric.axis: The weakest confidence among the facts cited by the axis. Evidence ids must resolve to facts.
confidenceRubric.overall: The weakest derived confidence among axes with nonzero default weight. PTO remains visible but does not control overall confidence because it has zero default weight.
confidenceRubric.readinessSeparation: Route readiness is an outcome and booking gate. A reroute-required or exact-2027-schedule-required conclusion may itself have high evidence confidence.
